correctness.rationale: Two-sided isolation is exactly the LL pattern for independent Poisson spacings. Conditioning on the outgoing gap being long yields independent regenerative blocks; a two-state first-passage recursion yields the exact Laplace transform and independent rare-thinning gives the geometric compound law. Direct symbolic differentiation yields the first two moments and rational Taylor expansion yields the sharp fixed-s correction. Finite Python checks independently verify transforms, moments and finite-n convergence. The proof and statement explicitly exclude uniformity and total-variation rates.
